claim_boundary: Primary evidence supports measuring realized volatility from intraday returns, treating short- and longer-horizon volatility components separately, and directly testing whether lower risk during elevated volatility improves implementable economics. It does not establish that the exact five-day to twenty-day realized-volatility ratio predicts Bitcoin returns or improves DRA entry selection. Exactly one separately frozen equal-capital historical screen may test whether admitting DRA entries only when the latest complete-day volatility-slope ratio is not elevated relative to its own prior twenty-day distribution improves risk-adjusted economics; feature redundancy or economic failure closes the exact family without tuning.

feature_contract.formula: sqrt(sum of the latest five complete UTC days of H1 close-to-close squared returns) divided by sqrt(sum of the latest twenty complete UTC days of the same squared returns), then divided by the median of exactly the prior twenty complete-day ratios

prior_matrix.finding: The paper develops realized volatility from high-frequency intraday returns and shows that realized-volatility dynamics can be modeled and forecast with standard time-series methods.
prior_matrix.identity: Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold and Labys, Modeling and Forecasting Realized Volatility, Econometrica 71 (2003)
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Foreign-exchange forecasting evidence does not establish a Bitcoin return signal, the exact five-to-twenty-day ratio, a rolling median threshold or DRA economics.

prior_matrix.finding: The HAR-RV model represents volatility with components over heterogeneous daily, weekly and monthly horizons and reports useful realized-volatility forecasting performance.
prior_matrix.identity: Corsi, A Simple Approximate Long-Memory Model of Realized Volatility, Journal of Financial Econometrics 7 (2009) 174-196
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The HAR cascade motivates separating short and longer volatility horizons but does not prescribe a ratio, a veto direction, thresholds or a trading policy.

prior_matrix.finding: Volatility-managed portfolios that reduce risk when volatility is high can improve risk-adjusted performance across several traditional factors and currency carry in the authors' sample.
prior_matrix.identity: Moreira and Muir, Volatility-Managed Portfolios, Journal of Finance 72 (2017) 1611-1644
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Traditional-asset factor evidence does not establish that vetoing unlevered BTC DRA entries improves total PnL, drawdown, holding time or terminal inventory after costs.

prior_matrix.finding: A broad re-evaluation of volatility-managed equity strategies finds that improvements are not systematic and that implementable out-of-sample utility and Sharpe evidence can be weak.
prior_matrix.identity: Cederburg, O'Doherty, Wang and Yan, On the Performance of Volatility-Managed Portfolios, Journal of Financial Economics 138 (2020) 95-117
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The exact BTC transfer must therefore pass matched-capital PnL, drawdown, realized/unrealized, annual breadth, holding, underwater-duration, concentration and neighbor gates rather than relying on volatility-management intuition.

pre_economic_redundancy_audit.formula: Spearman correlation of the daily five-to-twenty-day realized-volatility ratio with contemporaneous twenty-day realized-volatility level, calculated separately before any strategy economics

real_time_design_requirements: Use only H1 close-to-close returns known by the latest complete UTC-day boundary and execute no earlier than the unchanged next-bar open.
Compute the short component from exactly five complete-day realized variances and the long component from exactly twenty; use the current complete day in both and no future bar.
Normalize the latest five-to-twenty-day ratio only by the median of exactly the prior twenty complete-day ratios.

Before economic interpretation, require the daily slope ratio to have absolute Spearman correlation at most 0.80 with the contemporaneous twenty-day realized-volatility level in both Design and Validation; otherwise close as a repackaged volatility-level factor.
Keep DRA parent side, entries, exits, lot cost, capacity, fee, adverse slippage, cooldown and next-bar fill clock unchanged.
Freeze primary 1.0 and neighbors 0.8 and 1.2 before outcome access; do not search another horizon, estimator, normalization, threshold or relation.

Require gate set V2 Design and Validation total and realized PnL improvement, annual breadth, drawdown and underwater non-inferiority, holding support, terminal inventory and neighbor stability; otherwise close the family.
Do not open post-2024 OOS or create a runtime rule from this prior audit.
uncertainty: No primary source directly validates this exact single-BTC five-to-twenty-day volatility-slope DRA admission rule.
The ratio may be a transformation of the already closed absolute realized-volatility family; the frozen correlation gate must close it before economics if so.
A five-day component may react after rather than before a harmful move, while a stricter threshold may remove profitable rebound participation.
H1 sampling and close-to-close squared returns are implementation approximations rather than noise-robust high-frequency realized-volatility estimators.
No post-2024 evidence, OOS, candidate, runtime filter or Trading path was accessed while freezing this prior.
